raw_problem.problem_text:
(a) 势函数是什么(替换方程 (4.52))? (设地球质量为 $m _ { \mathrm { E } }$ ，太阳质量为 $M$ )  
(b) 该体系的"玻尔半径" $\lvert a _ { \mathrm { g } }$ 是什么?给出具体数值.  
写出重力的"玻尔公式"，令 $E _ { n }$ 等同于行星在半径为 $r _ { 0 }$ 的圆轨道上的经典能量，证明: $n = \sqrt { r _ { 0 } / a _ { \mathrm { g } } }$ 并依此估算地球的量子数 $n$   
(d) 假设地球向下一个 $( n - 1 )$ 能级跃迁.将会释放多少能量(以焦耳为单位)?辐射的光子波长(或者更可能是引力子)是多少? (用光年表示你的结果一一这个惊人的答案①是巧合吗? )

(a) 万有引力表达式为
raw_problem.solution_text:
$$
F = G \frac {M m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{r ^ {2}}.
$$

引力势能为引力的积分结果(通常定义无穷远处为势能零点，将物体从无穷远处(初始位置)移到 $r ^ { \prime }$ 处(终点位置)势能的减小量则为该处的寻|力势能):

$$
V \left(r\right) = \int_ {\infty} ^ {r} G \frac {M m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{r ^ {\prime 2}} \mathrm {d} r ^ {\prime} = - G \frac {M m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{r ^ {\prime}} \Bigg | _ {\infty} ^ {r} = - G \frac {M m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{r}.
$$

而氢原子的势能为

$$
- \frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}} \frac {1}{r},
$$

所以 $G M m _ { \mathrm { E } }$ 相当 $\frac { e ^ { 2 } } { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } }$ e24:lteo

己知氢原子的玻尔半径 $a = \left( \frac { 4 \pi \varepsilon _ { 0 } } { e ^ { 2 } } \right) \frac { \hbar ^ { 2 } } { m }$ ，所以此体系的玻尔半径为e2

$$
\begin{array}{l} a _ {\mathrm {g}} = \frac {\hbar^ {2}}{G M m _ {\mathrm {E}} ^ {2}} \\ = \frac {\left(1 . 0 5 4 6 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 4} \mathrm {J} \cdot \mathrm {s}\right) ^ {2}}{\left(6 . 6 7 2 6 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 1} \mathrm {m} ^ {3} / (\mathrm {k g} \cdot \mathrm {s})\right) \left(1 . 9 8 9 2 \times 1 0 ^ {3 0} \mathrm {k g}\right) \left(5 . 9 8 \times 1 0 ^ {2 4} \mathrm {k g}\right) ^ {2}} \\ = 2. 3 4 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 3 8} \mathrm {m}. \\ \end{array}
$$

(c) 由氢原子的能级为

$$
E _ {n} = - \left(\frac {e ^ {2}}{4 \pi \varepsilon_ {0}}\right) ^ {2} \frac {m _ {\mathrm {e}}}{2 \hbar^ {2} n ^ {2}},
$$

类比得到此体系的能级为

$$
E _ {n} = - \left(G M m _ {\mathrm {E}}\right) ^ {2} \frac {m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{2 \hbar^ {2} n ^ {2}}.
$$

当半径为 $r$ 时，体系的经典能量为

$$
E _ {c} = \frac {1}{2} m _ {\mathrm {E}} v ^ {2} - G \frac {M m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{r}.
$$

由向心力与向心力日速度的关系为

$$
\begin{array}{l} G \frac {M m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{r ^ {2}} = \frac {m _ {\mathrm {E}} v ^ {2}}{r} \\ \Rightarrow \frac {1}{2} m _ {\mathrm {E}} v ^ {2} = G \frac {M m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{2 r}. \\ \end{array}
$$

所以当半径为 $r _ { 0 }$ 时，

$$
\begin{array}{l} E _ {c} = - G \frac {M m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{2 r _ {0}} = - \left[ \frac {m _ {\mathrm {E}}}{2 \hbar^ {2}} (G M m _ {\mathrm {E}}) ^ {2} \right] \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \\ \Rightarrow n = \sqrt {G \frac {M m _ {\mathrm {E}} ^ {2}}{\hbar^ {2}} r _ {0}} = \sqrt {\frac {r _ {0}}{a _ {g}}}. \\ \end{array}
$$

取 $r _ { 0 }$ 为地球绕太阳的行星轨道半径 $\left( 1 . 4 9 6 \times 1 0 ^ { 1 1 } \mathrm { m } \right)$ ，则

$$
n = \sqrt {\frac {1 . 4 9 6 \times 1 0 ^ {1 1}}{2 . 3 4 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 3 8}}} = 2. 5 3 \times 1 0 ^ {7 4}.
$$

(d)

$$
\Delta E = - \left[ \frac {G ^ {2} M ^ {2} m _ {\mathrm {E}} ^ {3}}{2 \hbar^ {2}} \right] \left[ \frac {1}{(n + 1) ^ {2}} - \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \right].
$$

利用近似公式

$$
\frac {1}{(n + 1) ^ {2}} = \frac {1}{n ^ {2} (1 + 1 / n) ^ {2}} \approx \frac {1}{n ^ {2}} \left(1 - \frac {2}{n}\right),
$$

所以

$$
{\frac {1}{(n + 1) ^ {2}}} - {\frac {1}{n ^ {2}}} \approx - {\frac {2}{n ^ {3}}}
$$

$$
\Rightarrow \Delta E = \frac {G M ^ {2} m _ {\mathrm {E}} ^ {3}}{\hbar^ {2} n ^ {3}}.
$$

将上式代入数据，得

$$
\Delta E = \frac {(6 . 6 7 \times 1 0 ^ {- 1 1}) ^ {2} (1 . 9 9 \times 1 0 ^ {3 0}) ^ {2} (5 . 9 8 \times 1 0 ^ {2 4}) ^ {3}}{(1 . 0 5 5 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 4}) ^ {2} (2 . 5 3 \times 1 0 ^ {7 4}) ^ {3}} = 2. 0 9 \times 1 0 ^ {- 4 1} (\mathrm {J}).
$$

辐射光子(或许引力子)的能量为

$$
E _ {\mathrm {p}} = \Delta E = h \nu = \frac {h c}{\lambda},
$$

$$
\lambda = \left(3 \times 1 0 ^ {8}\right) \left(6. 6 3 \times 1 0 ^ {- 3 4}\right) / \left(2. 0 9 \times 1 0 ^ {- 4 1}\right) = 9. 5 2 \times 1 0 ^ {1 5} (\mathrm {m}).
$$

光年为 $9 . 4 6 \times 1 0 ^ { 1 5 } \mathrm { ~ m ~ }$ ，与 $\lambda$ 非常接近.辐射光子的波长为 光年是一种巧合么?实际不然.

(c) $n ^ { 2 } = G M m _ { E } ^ { 2 } r _ { 0 } / \hbar ^ { 2 }$ ，所以波长可以表示为

$$
\begin{array}{l} \lambda = \frac {h c}{\Delta E} \approx 2 \pi \hbar c \frac {\hbar^ {2} n ^ {3}}{(G M m _ {\mathrm {E}}) ^ {2} m _ {\mathrm {E}}} \\ = \frac {2 \pi \hbar^ {3} c}{G ^ {2} M ^ {2} m _ {\mathrm {E}} ^ {3}} \left(\frac {G M m _ {\mathrm {E}} ^ {2} r}{\hbar^ {2}}\right) ^ {3 / 2} = c \left(2 \pi \sqrt {\frac {r ^ {3}}{G M}}\right). \\ \end{array}
$$

由于地球速度

$$
v = \sqrt {G M / r _ {0}} = 2 \pi r _ {0} / T,
$$

(其中 $T$ 为轨道周期，对地球为 年.)所以

$$
T = 2 \pi \sqrt {r _ {0} ^ {3} / (G M)}.
$$

披长与轨道周期关系为 $\lambda = c T$ 当 $T$ 年时，波长为 光年.巧合的是，对氢原子也有这样的关系.从极高的激发态向下一能级跃迁时发射的光子披长等于光在一个轨道周期内传播的距离.

*习题 4.21 升阶算符和降阶算符将 $m$ 的值改变一个单位:

$$
L _ {+} f _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \left(A _ {l} ^ {m}\right) f _ {\ell} ^ {m + 1}, \quad L _ {-} f _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \left(B _ {\ell} ^ {m}\right) f _ {\ell} ^ {m - 1},
$$

其中 $A _ { \ell } ^ { m }$ 和 $B _ { \ell } ^ { m }$ 为常数.问题:如果本征函数要归一化，它们是什么?提示 首先证明 $L _ { \mp }$ 是 $L _ { \pm }$ 的厄米共辄算符(因为 $L _ { x }$ 和 $L _ { y }$ 是可观测的力学量，你可以假定它们是厄米算符. . ... ... ... ~但如果你乐意，可以证明它);再利用方程 (4.112). 答案:

$$
A _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \hbar \sqrt {\ell (\ell + 1) - m (m + 1)} = \hbar \sqrt {(\ell - m) (\ell + m + 1)},
$$

$$
B _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \hbar \sqrt {\ell (\ell + 1) - m (m - 1)} = \hbar \sqrt {(\ell + m) (\ell - m + 1)}.
$$

注意梯子顶部和梯子底部会发生什么情况(即把 $L _ { + }$ 作用在 $f _ { l } ^ { l }$ 上，或者 $L _ { - }$ 作用在$f _ { l } ^ { - l } \ \bot )$ .

解答首先证明 $L _ { \mp }$ 是 $L _ { \pm }$ 的厄米共辄算符，

$$
\begin{array}{l} \langle f | L _ {\pm} g \rangle = \langle f | L _ {x} g \rangle \pm \mathrm {i} \langle f | L _ {y} g \rangle \\ = \left\langle L _ {x} f | g \right\rangle \pm \left\langle L _ {y} f | g \right\rangle \\ = \left\langle \left(L _ {x} \mp \mathrm {i} L _ {y}\right) f | g \right\rangle \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
= \langle L _ {\mp} f | g \rangle ,
$$

所以

$$
(L _ {\pm}) ^ {\dagger} = L _ {\mp}.
$$

由

$$
\begin{array}{l} L _ {\mp} L _ {\pm} = \left(L _ {x} \mp \mathrm {i} L _ {y}\right) \left(L _ {x} \pm \mathrm {i} L _ {y}\right) \\ = L _ {x} ^ {2} + L _ {y} ^ {2} \pm \mathrm {i} L _ {x} L _ {y} \mp \mathrm {i} L _ {y} L _ {x} \\ = L _ {x} ^ {2} + L _ {y} ^ {2} \mp \mathrm {i} \left(L _ {y} L _ {x} - \mathrm {i} L _ {x} L _ {y}\right) \\ = L ^ {2} - L _ {z} ^ {2} \mp \mathrm {i} [ L _ {y}, L _ {x} ] \\ = L ^ {2} - L _ {z} ^ {2} \mp \hbar L _ {z}. \\ \end{array}
$$

得

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \mid L _ {\mp} L _ {\pm} f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \right\rangle = \left\langle f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \mid \left(L ^ {2} - L _ {z} ^ {2} \mp \hbar L _ {z}\right) f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \right\rangle \\ = \left\langle f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \right| \left[ \hbar^ {2} \ell (\ell + 1) - \hbar^ {2} m ^ {2} \mp \hbar^ {2} m \right] f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \rangle \\ = \hbar^ {2} [ \ell (\ell + 1) - m (m \pm 1) ] \langle f _ {\ell} ^ {m} | f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \rangle \\ = \hbar^ {2} \left[ \ell (\ell + 1) - m (m \pm 1) \right], \\ \end{array}
$$

而另一方面

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left\langle f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \right| L _ {\mp} L _ {\pm} f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \rangle = \left\langle L _ {\pm} f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \right| L _ {\pm} f _ {\ell} ^ {m} \rangle \\ = \left\langle A _ {\ell} ^ {m} f _ {\ell} ^ {m \pm 1} \mid A _ {\ell} ^ {m} f _ {\ell} ^ {m \pm 1} \right\rangle \\ = \left| A _ {\ell} ^ {m} \right| ^ {2} \langle f _ {\ell} ^ {m \pm 1} | f _ {\ell} ^ {m \pm 1} \rangle \\ = \left| A _ {\ell} ^ {m} \right| ^ {2}, \\ \end{array}
$$

所以(不计任意相因子)，

$$
A _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \hbar \sqrt {\ell (\ell + 1) - m (m \pm 1)},
$$

或者拆开写为

$$
A _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \hbar \sqrt {\ell (\ell + 1) - m (m + 1)} = \hbar \sqrt {(\ell - m) (\ell + m + 1)},
$$

$$
B _ {\ell} ^ {m} = \hbar \sqrt {\ell (\ell + 1) - m (m - 1)} = \hbar \sqrt {(\ell + m) (\ell - m + 1)}.
$$

# 申习题 4.22

(a) 由位置和动量的正则对易关系(方程 4.10 式)，求下列对易关系:

$$
[ L _ {z}, x ] = \mathrm {i} \hbar y, [ L _ {z}, y ] = - \mathrm {i} \hbar x, [ L _ {z}, z ] = 0;
$$

$$
\left[ L _ {z}, p _ {x} \right] = \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {y}, \left[ L _ {z}, p _ {y} \right] = - \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {x}, \left[ L _ {z}, p _ {z} \right] = 0.
$$

(b) 利用这些结果直接从方程 (4.96) 中推导出 $[ L _ { z } , \ L _ { x } ] = \mathrm { i } \hbar L _ { y }$   
(c) 计算对易子 $\textstyle [ L _ { z } , \ r ^ { 2 } ]$ 和 $[ L _ { z } , \ p ^ { 2 } ]$ $p ^ { 2 } ]$ (当然，这里 $r ^ { 2 } = x ^ { 2 } + y ^ { 2 } + z ^ { 2 } , p ^ { 2 } = p _ { x } ^ { 2 } +$ $p _ { y } ^ { 2 } + p _ { z } ^ { 2 } )$   
(d) 证明:当 $V$ 仅依赖于 $r$ 时，哈密顿量 $H = ( p ^ { 2 } / 2 m ) + V$ 与 $\pmb { L }$ 的三个分量

都对易

(因此 $L ^ { 2 }$ , $L _ { z }$ 是相互兼容的可观测力学量.)

解答 (a) 己知角动量算符

$$
\boldsymbol {L} = \left[ \begin{array}{c c c} \hat {x} & \hat {y} & \hat {z} \\ x & y & z \\ p _ {x} & p _ {y} & p _ {z} \end{array} \right] = \left[ \left(y p _ {z} - z p _ {y}\right) \hat {x}, \left(z p _ {x} - x p _ {z}\right) \hat {y}, \left(x p _ {y} - y p _ {x}\right) \hat {z} \right].
$$

则

$$
[ L _ {z}, x ] = [ x p _ {y} - y p _ {x}, x ] = [ x p _ {y}, x ] - [ y p _ {x}, x ] = 0 - y [ p _ {x}, x ] = \mathrm {i} \hbar y.
$$

$$
[ L _ {z}, y ] = [ x p _ {y} - y p _ {x}, y ] = [ x p _ {y}, y ] - [ y p _ {x}, y ] = x [ p _ {y}, y ] - 0 = - \mathrm {i} \hbar x.
$$

$$
[ L _ {z}, z ] = [ x p _ {y} - y p _ {x}, z ] = [ x p _ {y}, z ] - [ y p _ {x}, z ] = 0.
$$

$$
\left[ L _ {z}, p _ {x} \right] = \left[ x p _ {y} - y p _ {x}, p _ {x} \right] = \left[ x p _ {y}, p _ {x} \right] - \left[ y p _ {x}, p _ {x} \right] = p _ {y} \left[ x, p _ {x} \right] - 0 = \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {y}.
$$

$$
[ L _ {z}, p _ {y} ] = [ x p _ {y} - y p _ {x}, p _ {y} ] = = 0 - p _ {x} [ y, p _ {y} ] = - \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {x}.
$$

$$
[ L _ {z}, p _ {z} ] = [ x p _ {y} - y p _ {x}, p _ {z} ] = [ x p _ {y}, p _ {z} ] - [ y p _ {x}, p _ {z} ] = 0.
$$

(b) 对易关系

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ L _ {z}, L _ {x} ] = [ L _ {z}, y p _ {z} - z p _ {y} ] = [ L _ {z}, y p _ {z} ] - [ L _ {z}, z p _ {y} ] = [ L _ {z}, y ] p _ {z} - z [ L _ {z}, p _ {y} ] \\ = - \mathrm {i} \hbar x p _ {z} + \mathrm {i} \hbar z p _ {x} = \mathrm {i} \hbar \left(z p _ {x} - x p _ {z}\right) = \mathrm {i} \hbar L _ {y}. \\ \end{array}
$$

循环指标，得

$$
\left[ L _ {y}, L _ {z} \right] = \mathrm {i} \hbar L _ {x}, \quad \left[ L _ {x}, L _ {y} \right] = \mathrm {i} \hbar L _ {z}.
$$

(c) 对易关系中，坐标以分量形式展开

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left[ L _ {z}, r ^ {2} \right] = \left[ L _ {z}, x ^ {2} \right] + \left[ L _ {z}, y ^ {2} \right] + \left[ L _ {z}, z ^ {2} \right] \\ = \left[ L _ {z}, x \right] x + x \left[ L _ {z}, x \right] + \left[ L _ {z}, y \right] y + y \left[ L _ {z}, y \right] + 0 \\ = \mathrm {i} \hbar y x + x \mathrm {i} \hbar y + (- \mathrm {i} \hbar x) y + y (- \mathrm {i} \hbar x) = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} \left[ L _ {z}, p ^ {2} \right] = \left[ L _ {z}, p _ {x} ^ {2} \right] + \left[ L _ {z}, p _ {y} ^ {2} \right] + \left[ L _ {z}, p _ {z} ^ {2} \right] \\ = p _ {x} \left[ L _ {z}, p _ {x} \right] + \left[ L _ {z}, p _ {x} \right] p _ {x} + p _ {y} \left[ L _ {z}, p _ {y} \right] + \left[ L _ {z}, p _ {y} \right] p _ {y} \\ = p _ {x} \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {y} + \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {y} p _ {x} + (- \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {x}) p _ {y} + p _ {y} (- \mathrm {i} \hbar p _ {x}) = 0. \\ \end{array}
$$

同样可证

$$
\left[ L _ {x}, r ^ {2} \right] = 0, \left[ L _ {y}, r ^ {2} \right] = 0, \left[ L _ {x}, p ^ {2} \right] = 0, \left[ L _ {y}, p ^ {2} \right] = 0.
$$

(d) $\pmb { L }$ 的三个分量都 $r ^ { 2 }$ 州 $p ^ { 2 }$ 易，所以与 $H = { \frac { p ^ { 2 } } { 2 m } } + V \left( { \sqrt { r ^ { 2 } } } \right)$ 对易

# **习题 4.23

(a) 证明:对处于势场 $V ( r )$ 中的粒子，其轨道角动量 $\pmb { L }$ 期望值的变化率等于力矩的期望值

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} t} \left<   \boldsymbol {L} \right> = \left<   \boldsymbol {N} \right > ,
$$

其中

$$
\boldsymbol {N} = \boldsymbol {r} \times (- \nabla V).
$$

(在转动情况下，这类同于埃伦菲斯特定理.)

(b) 证明:对任意球对称势都有 $\mathrm { d } \left. \pmb { L } \right. / \mathrm { d } t = 0$ .(这是角动量守恒的一种量子表述形式)

证明 (a) 由算符期望值随时间变化公式(方程 (3.73))

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d}}{\mathrm {d} t} \left<   \hat {Q} \right> = \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\hbar} \left<   \left[ \hat {H}, \hat {Q} \right]\right> + \left<   \frac {\partial \hat {Q}}{\partial t} \right > ,
$$

可得

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \langle L _ {x} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\hbar} \left\langle [ H, L _ {x} ] \right\rangle + \left\langle \frac {\partial L _ {x}}{\partial t} \right\rangle = \frac {\mathrm {i}}{\hbar} \left\langle [ H, L _ {x} ] \right\rangle ,
$$

其中， [H "，] = $\left[ H , L _ { x } \right] = \frac { 1 } { 2 m } \left[ p ^ { 2 } , L _ { x } \right] + \left[ V , L _ { x } \right] .$

由习题 ，知上式对易关系第一项为零;如果势能 $V$ 是一个标量，则第二项也为零.但一般情况下， $V ( r )$ 是矢量 $\mathbfit { \Delta } \mathbf { r }$ 的函数

$$
[ H, L _ {x} ] = [ V, y p _ {z} - z p _ {y} ] = y [ V, p _ {z} ] - z [ V, p _ {y} ].
$$

由习题 4.1(b) 的证明过程知: $[ f ( x ) , p _ { x } ] = \mathrm { i } \hbar \frac { \partial f } { \partial x }$ ，所以

$$
[ V, p _ {z} ] = \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial V}{\partial z}, \quad [ V, p _ {y} ] = \mathrm {i} \hbar \frac {\partial V}{\partial y}.
$$

$$
\begin{array}{l} [ H, L _ {x} ] = y \mathrm {i} \hbar {\frac {\partial V}{\partial z}} - z \mathrm {i} \hbar {\frac {\partial V}{\partial y}} = \mathrm {i} \hbar \left[ \boldsymbol {r} \times (\nabla V) \right] _ {x} (x \text {分 量}) \\ \Rightarrow \frac {\mathrm {d} \langle L _ {x} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = - \left\langle [ \boldsymbol {r} \times (\nabla V) ] _ {x} \right\rangle . \\ \end{array}
$$

同理可得，

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \langle L _ {y} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = - \left\langle [ \boldsymbol {r} \times (\nabla V) ] _ {y} \right\rangle
$$

和

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \langle L _ {z} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = - \left\langle [ \boldsymbol {r} \times (\nabla V) ] _ {z} \right\rangle .
$$

所以

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \langle \boldsymbol {L} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = \langle \boldsymbol {r} \times (- \nabla V) \rangle = \langle \boldsymbol {N} \rangle .
$$

(b) 对球对称势有 $V \left( r \right) = V \left( r \right)$ 其中 $V \left( r \right)$ 只与到球心的距离有关，则

$\nabla V = \frac { \partial V } { \partial r } \nabla r = \frac { \partial V } { \partial r } \frac { r } { r } = \frac { \partial V } { \partial r } \hat { r }$ (对标量 $r$ 的梯度为单位矢量f')

其中 $\hat { r }$ 是沿 $\mathbfit { \Delta } \mathbf { r }$ 方向的单位矢量，则

$\boldsymbol { r } \times \left( - \boldsymbol { \nabla } V \right) = - \left( \boldsymbol { r } \times \boldsymbol { \hat { r } } \right) \frac { \partial V } { \partial \boldsymbol { r } } = 0 .$ (同一方向的矢量叉乘等于零)

所以，

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} \langle \boldsymbol {L} \rangle}{\mathrm {d} t} = 0.
$$

# 事*习题 4.24

(a) 由方程 (4.130) 推导方程 (4.131). 提示 利用试探函数，否则可能会丢失掉某些项.  
(b) 由方程 (4.129) (4.131) 推导方程 (4.132). 提示 利用方程 (4.112).

解答 (a) 方程 (4.130)

$$
L _ {\pm} = \pm \hbar \mathrm {e} ^ {\pm \mathrm {i} \phi} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \pm \mathrm {i} \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi}\right).
$$

设 $f$ 是一个任意函数，则

$$
\begin{array}{l} L _ {+} L _ {-} f = - \hbar^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} + \mathrm {i} \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi}\right) \left[ \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \left(\frac {\partial f}{\partial \theta} - \mathrm {i} \cot \theta \frac {\partial f}{\partial \phi}\right) \right] \\ = - \hbar^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \left\{\mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \left[ \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial \theta^ {2}} - \mathrm {i} \left(- \csc^ {2} \theta \frac {\partial f}{\partial \phi} + \cot \theta \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial \theta \partial \phi}\right) \right] \right\} \\ - \hbar^ {2} \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \mathrm {i} \cot \theta \left[ - \mathrm {i} \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \left(\frac {\partial f}{\partial \theta} - \mathrm {i} \cot \theta \frac {\partial f}{\partial \phi}\right) + \mathrm {e} ^ {- \mathrm {i} \phi} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial \phi \partial \theta} - \mathrm {i} \cot \theta \frac {\partial^ {2} f}{\partial \phi^ {2}}\right) \right] \\ = - \hbar^ {2} \left[ \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \theta^ {2}} + \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} + \cot^ {2} \theta \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}} + i (\csc^ {2} \theta - \cot^ {2} \theta) \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi} \right] f. \\ \end{array}
$$

等式两边同时移除试探函数 $f$ 得

$$
L _ {+} L _ {-} = - \hbar^ {2} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \theta} + \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} + \cot^ {2} \theta \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}} + \mathrm {i} \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi}\right).
$$

(b) 由方程 (4.129) $L _ { z } = - \mathrm { i } \hbar \frac { \partial } { \partial \phi }$ 及方程 (4.112) ${ \cal L } ^ { 2 } = { \cal L } _ { \pm } { \cal L } _ { \mp } + { \cal L } _ { z } ^ { 2 } \mp \hbar { \cal L } _ { z }$ 利用 (a) 中的结果，得

$$
\begin{array}{l} L ^ {2} = - \hbar^ {2} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \theta^ {2}} + \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} + \cot^ {2} \theta \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}} + \mathrm {i} \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi}\right) - \hbar^ {2} \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}} - \hbar \left(\frac {\hbar}{\mathrm {i}}\right) \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi} \\ = - \hbar^ {2} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \theta^ {2}} + \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} + \left(\cot^ {2} \theta + 1\right) \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}} + \mathrm {i} \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi} - \mathrm {i} \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi}\right) \\ = - \hbar^ {2} \left(\frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \theta^ {2}} + \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} + \frac {1}{\sin^ {2} \theta} \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}}\right) \\ = - \hbar^ {2} \left[ \frac {1}{\sin \theta} \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} \left(\sin \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \theta}\right) + \frac {1}{\sin^ {2} \theta} \frac {\partial^ {2}}{\partial \phi^ {2}} \right]. \\ \end{array}
$$

# *习题 4.25

(a) $L _ { + } Y _ { \ell } ^ { \ell }$ 是什么? (不允许计算! )  
(b) 利用 (a) 的结果，连同方程 (4.130) $L _ { z } Y _ { \ell } ^ { \ell } = \hbar \ell Y _ { \ell } ^ { \ell }$ ，确定 $Y _ { \ell } ^ { \ell } ( \theta , \phi )$ 和归化常数.  
通过直接积分确定归一化常数.将你的最终结果与习题 中的结果进行比较.

解答 (叫 $L _ { + } Y _ { \ell } ^ { \ell } = 0$ . (这里 $m = \ell$ 已是最高的量子数，不能再升阶.)

(b) 角动量算符的 $z$ 分量作用在球谐波函数

$$
L _ {z} Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} = \hbar l Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} \Rightarrow \frac {\hbar}{\mathrm {i}} \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi} Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} = \hbar \ell Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}, \text {得}
$$

$$
\frac {\partial Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}}{\partial \phi} = \mathrm {i} \ell Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell}, \quad Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} = f (\theta) \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \ell \phi}.
$$

$$
L _ {+} Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} = 0,
$$

$$
\hbar \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \left(\frac {\partial}{\partial \theta} + \mathrm {i} \cot \theta \frac {\partial}{\partial \phi}\right) [ f (\theta) \mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \ell \phi} ] = 0,
$$

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} f}{\mathrm {d} \theta} - \ell \cot \theta f (\theta) = 0,
$$

$$
\frac {\mathrm {d} f}{f} = \ell \cot \theta \mathrm {d} \theta ,
$$

$$
\ln f = \ell \ln (\sin \theta) + C,
$$

$$
f (\theta) = A \sin^ {\ell} \theta ,
$$

其中 $C$ 为常数，所以

$$
Y _ {\ell} ^ {\ell} (\theta , \phi) = A \left(\mathrm {e} ^ {\mathrm {i} \phi} \sin \theta\right) ^ {\ell}.
$$

(c) 波函数归一化

$$
\begin{array}{l} 1 = A ^ {2} \int \sin^ {2 \ell} \theta \sin \theta \mathrm {d} \theta \mathrm {d} \phi = 2 \pi A ^ {2} \int_ {0} ^ {\pi} \sin^ {2 \ell + 1} \theta \mathrm {d} \theta = 2 \pi A ^ {2} 2 \frac {2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2 \ell)}{1 \cdot 3 \cdot 5 \cdots (2 \ell + 1)} \\ = 4 \pi A ^ {2} \frac {\left[ 2 \cdot 4 \cdot 6 \cdots (2 \ell) \right] ^ {2}}{1 \cdot 2 \cdot 3 \cdot 4 \cdots (2 \ell + 1)} = 4 \pi A ^ {2} \frac {\left(2 ^ {\ell} \ell !\right) ^ {2}}{(2 \ell + 1) !}. \\ \end{array}
$$

得

$$
A = \frac {1}{2 ^ {\ell + 1} l !} \sqrt {\frac {(2 \ell + 1) !}{\pi}}.
$$

除了一个任意的相因子 $( - 1 ) ^ { \ell }$ ，这与习题 4.7 的结果是一样的.
